requirement_assessment.requirement: original Uh_pfas100 bytes or direct institutional lineage evidence
requirement_assessment.reason: No reviewed document contains Uh_pfas100 vector bytes. The 2007 study states that INRENA digital cartography with Pfafstetter N7 delineation was used; that is lineage of the 2007 study to INRENA, not lineage of the current MINAM ServicioActivacionQuebrada layer to Uh_pfas100. A 2007 document cannot attest the provenance of a later service.

requirement_assessment.requirement: preserved comparison of every current/historical name and area delta
requirement_assessment.reason: The historical side (2007 names and areas) is frozen. The current side exists only as PR #339 live observations and an ephemeral CI artifact; no current per-code attributes derived from committed raw bytes with SHA-256 exist in the repository to compare against.

requirement_assessment.requirement: independent evidence sufficient to establish geometric equivalence
requirement_assessment.reason: Documentary sources supply names, codes, areas, topology and map images only. Contract forbids PDF digitization, so no reviewed evidence yields comparable polygon coordinates. Observed area drift (sum delta -0.9614 km2) and name/designator drift remain unexplained without lineage.

OR an institutional statement (MINAM or ANA metadata, service documentation or official letter) that ServicioActivacionQuebrada layer 1 is derived from Uh_pfas100 without re-delineation, with any edits enumerated
Committed Gate A raw per-code MINAM responses plus SHA-256 so the current-side name and area comparison is reproducible from repository bytes
Given original bytes: a preregistered geometric comparison (per-code symmetric difference / Hausdorff after a documented WGS84 to EPSG:32718 transform) reported without post-hoc tolerance
Archived public bytes plus SHA-256 of the ANA 2007 hydrologic study and surface-water inventory PDFs (currently PENDING_ARCHIVE_OF_PUBLIC_BYTES)
